visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male doctor with dark hair wearing a white lab coat sits behind a light-colored desk in a clinic setting. Across from him is a woman in a vibrant yellow and black patterned sweater. Behind them, a female nurse in a white uniform stands attentively. The background features a human anatomy poster and medical supplies. The woman uses her hands to point to her lower face and jaw while talking with a concerned expression. (2) The camera cuts to a closer shot of the doctor and the female patient. She has a frustrated facial expression, her mouth open as she questions the doctor's specialty. The doctor holds his hands up in a clarifying gesture, looking calm. Brightly colored text bubbles in yellow and blue pop up near her head to emphasize her disbelief. The lighting is very bright and even across the whole set. (3) The scene shifts to a new encounter in the same office. A young man wearing a white t-shirt with a cartoon graphic is now seated in front of the doctor, holding a large, fluffy gray cat in his arms. He points at the cat's fur while the doctor leans in to observe. The cat looks directly into the camera lens with wide, curious eyes before the video cuts to a black screen.
